name: BetterCloud
summary: BetterCloud discovers sanctioned and unsanctioned apps through SSO, a browser extension and ERP data. It finds underused licenses through direct integrations and sets renewal reminders at 30, 60 or 90 days. Spend Optimization Basic is listed at $0 a month, and other modules are quoted.

facts.text: BetterCloud says it discovers sanctioned and unsanctioned SaaS apps via SSO, a browser extension and ERP data.
BetterCloud lists direct integrations with Zoom, Salesforce and Microsoft 365 for feature-level usage insights.
BetterCloud offers custom 30, 60 and 90 day key date alerts for renewals.
BetterCloud says it holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, and offers a pre-signed data processing addendum for GDPR.

plans.name: Spend Optimization (full module)
plans.notes: The page says price reflects license count, connected apps, chosen modules and add-ons.

hiddenCosts: Add-ons such as Data Loss Prevention are priced separately, per the pricing page.
